auth.title: Sign in
auth.error: Wrong email or password. Check them and try again.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a minute.
upload.title: Upload purchase history
upload.intro: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV export from 1C, SAP or any accounting system. Nothing is stored until you confirm the columns.
upload.drop: Drop a file here or choose one
upload.tooLarge: The file is larger than 25 MB. Split it by period and upload the parts.
upload.mappingHint: We suggested a column for each field. Change any that are wrong. Required: item, price (or total and quantity), date.
upload.duplicate: This file was already uploaded. Nothing was imported twice.
review.title: Review queue
review.intro: Lines we could not match with enough confidence. Choose the right item; each decision also improves the matcher's test set.
review.sampleHint: Codes are synthetic until real ЕНС ТРУ data is connected.
review.emptyHint: New uploads with uncertain lines will appear here.
review.keys: Keys: J/K move, A accept, R no match, 1–5 choose, U undo
review.bundledHint: Excluded from price comparison until split.
review.noCandidates: No similar items in the classifier.
findings.title: Findings
findings.noneHint: Run the analysis after matching. Only lines with a confirmed item and price take part.
findings.draft: Draft: the client sees it only after review and release.
findings.staffOnly: Only reviewers can run the analysis.
findings.error: The analysis stopped because two independent calculations disagreed. Nothing was saved.
ingest.error.too_large: The file is larger than 25 MB. Split it by period.
ingest.error.unsupported_type: Use .xlsx or .csv. Old .xls and macro files (.xlsm) are not accepted.
ingest.error.unreadable: The file cannot be read. It may be damaged or password-protected. Save it again without a password.
ingest.error.macros: The workbook contains macros. Save it as a normal .xlsx file without macros.
ingest.error.encoding: The text encoding is not recognised. Save the CSV as UTF-8.
ingest.error.too_many_rows: More than 200,000 rows. Split the file by period.
ingest.error.bad_mapping: Choose columns for item, price and date.
ingest.error.forbidden: Your role cannot upload purchase data in this organization.
ingest.row.missing_item: Row {row}: the item name is empty. Fill it in or skip the row.
ingest.row.missing_date: Row {row}: the date is missing. Fix the file or skip the row.
ingest.row.bad_date: Row {row}: the date is not valid (expected 14.03.2026). Fix the file or skip the row.
ingest.row.bad_number: Row {row}: a number cannot be read. Check the price and quantity.
ingest.row.missing_price: Row {row}: no price and no total with quantity.
ingest.row.unknown_currency: Row {row}: the currency is not recognised (use KZT, USD, RUB, EUR or CNY).
